e-03.title: Gqiba oko kuza kubuzwa phambi kokuphendula
e-03.goal: Gqiba ulwazi olufunayo ngokwenene phambi kokuphendula umyalezo wesimemo, uze ubhale impendulo emfutshane yesiNgesi ebuza ngalo.
e-03.material:
Ufumene umyalezo kumhlobo wakho u-Ari. "Let's play soccer tomorrow!"
Ucinga ukuba kuvakala kakuhle, kodwa lo myalezo wodwa awonelanga ukugqiba ukuba unokuya na.
e-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke into ekufuneka uyazi ukuze uphendule 'ndingaya.'
e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Khangela ukuba impendulo yombuzo ngamnye sele ifumaneka kumbhalo na.
e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Zama umbuzo ngamnye omnye ngomnye: ukuba awunayo impendulo yawo, ungathi 'ndiza kuza'?
e-03.s.s1.r.a: Ixesha liyafuneka. Kodwa ngale nto yodwa, awukwazi ukuya ngaphi. Khangela ukuba ikho enye into efunekayo na.
e-03.s.s1.r.b: Indawo iyafuneka. Kodwa ngale nto yodwa, awukwazi ukuba lixesha elingakanani. Khangela ukuba ikho enye into efunekayo na.
e-03.s.s1.r.c: Ibhola ilungile ukuba nayo, kodwa ayifuneki ukugqiba ukuba unokuya na.
e-03.s.s1.r.d: Isenokunceda, kodwa unokugqiba ukuba unokuya na ngaphandle kwayo. Cinga ukuba ngokwenene ilulwazi olufunekayo na.
e-03.s.s1.r.e: U-Ari sele ethe masidlale ibhola ekhatywayo. Oku kubuza ngento osele uyaziyo.
e-03.s.s1.r.f: Ukwazi isizathu kulungile ngenxa yokunqwenela ukwazi, kodwa akufuneki ukugqiba ukuba unokuya na. Umbuzo awufuneki nje kuba uqala ngegama lombuzo.
e-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba awulazi ixesha nendawo, awukwazi ukugqiba ukuba ihambelana nesicwangciso sakho okanye ukuba unokufika kuyo. Ukuba ukhethe enye kuphela, vavanya kwakhona: ngaphandle kwenye, ungathi 'ndiza kuza'? (Ukuba uyalazi ixesha kuphela, awazi apho uya khona; ukuba uyayazi indawo kuphela, awazi ixesha.)
e-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kuyinto yemvelo ukufuna ukwazi ukuba ngubani ozayo nawo. Kodwa eyona nto iphambili kukuba awukwazi ukuphendula ngaphandle kwexesha nendawo.
e-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhalela u-Ari impendulo ngesiNgesi. Bonisa ukuba ufuna ukudibana, uze uquke umbuzo ocela ulwazi olukhethe ngasentla.
e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala, bhala ibinzana elifutshane elithetha 'Kuvakala kakuhle!'
e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Unokudibanisa nemibuzo emibini oyikhethileyo ibe sisivakalisi esinye.
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Emva kokufunda impendulo yam, ngaba u-Ari unokundixelela ixesha nendawo?
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba iquka impendulo enobuhlobo nemibuzo zombini?

e-09.title: Phambi kokuphendula i-'Could you look at it at some point?' yomncinci
e-09.goal: Khetha ulwazi olulahlekileyo kwisicelo esingacacanga, ubhale impendulo yesiNgesi ebandakanya ngentlonipho imibuzo oyifunayo.
e-09.material:
Ufumene umyalezo kumfundi ongunyaka o-1 ngaphantsi kwakho. Anazani kakhulu.

"Hi! Sorry to bother you, but could you look at my essay at some point? Thanks!!"

Ufuna ukunceda, kodwa uphithizelekile kule veki.
e-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke into ofuna ukuyazi phambi kokuphendula, ukuze ugqibe ukuba ungancedisa na, uncede ngokufanelekileyo.
e-09.s.s1.hint.0: Faka umgca ngezantsi kumagama angacacanga emyalezweni, ubhale umgca omnye ngegama ngalinye ngezizathu zokuba kutheni eli gama lenza isigqibo sakho sibe nzima.
e-09.s.s1.hint.1: Zama umbuzo ngamnye: ukuba awunampendulo, ungathi 'Yes, I'll do it'?
e-09.s.s1.r.a: Umhla wokugqibela uyafuneka. Kodwa kule nto kuphela awazi ukuba luhlobo luni lwenkxaso olufunekayo. Jonga ukuba ikhona na eminye imibuzo oyidingayo.
e-09.s.s1.r.b: Uhlobo lwenkxaso luyafuneka. Kodwa kule nto kuphela awazi ukuba kufuneka kugqitywe ngaphambi kwexesha elithini. Jonga ukuba ikhona na eminye imibuzo oyidingayo.
e-09.s.s1.r.c: Ubude buyafuneka ukuqikelela ixesha. Jonga ukuba eminye imibuzo iyafuneka nayo.
e-09.s.s1.r.d: Amanqaku onyaka ophelileyo awanxulumani ngokuthe ngqo nokuba ungayinceda na le ssay, okanye ngokuba ngayiphi indlela.
e-09.s.s1.r.e: Ukuba banayo enye inkxaso akutshintshi ukuba ungancedisa na, okanye ngayiphi indlela.
e-09.s.s1.explain: 'At some point' ayicaci ngexesha, kwaye 'look at' ayicaci ngohlobo lwenkxaso. Kufuneka wazi umhla wokugqibela, inkxaso efunwayo, nobude ukuze ugqibe ukuba ungalwenza ixesha na. Ukuba ukhethe ezinye kuphela, vavanya ukuba ungancedisa ngaphandle kwempendulo yombuzo owushiyileyo.
e-09.s.s1.acc.0: Umhla wokugqibela noluhlobo lwenkxaso efunwayo ngamanqaku aphambili, kwaye ubude yinto oyifundayo emva kokuyifumana, ngoko ukuyishiya kunengqiqo.
e-09.s.s1.acc.1: Kunengqiqo nokuba uqale ugqibe ngomhla wokugqibela nobude ukuba ungalwenza ixesha na, ubuze ngohlobo lwenkxaso kamva.
e-09.s.s1.acc.2: Nangona uphithizelekile kule veki, ungaqala uqikelele ukuba ungancedisa na ngohlobo lwenkxaso efunekayo nobude. Kodwa uza kudinga ukwazi umhla wokugqibela kungekudala.
e-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhalela omncinci impendulo ngesiNgesi. Bonisa ngentlonipho ukuba ukulungele ukunceda, ubandakanye ubuncinane imibuzo emibini kuleyo uyikhethe ngasentla.
e-09.s.s2.hint.0: Gqiba imibuzo emibini enokutshintsha ukuba ungancedisa na, okanye ngayiphi indlela.
e-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umbuzo omnye kwisivakalisi ngasinye, ubeke ibinzana lokunceda ekuqaleni kwaphela.
e-09.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: Sure, I'd be happy to help! ...
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Emva kokufunda impendulo yam, ngaba omncinci unokundixelela umhla wokugqibela nenkxaso ayifunayo?
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba unokubona zombini umnqweno wokunceda nemibuzo?
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ithoni ifanelekile kumntu omaziyo kancinane?

e-10.title: Ukwala okunentlonipho, okanye ikho into enokwenzeka?
e-10.goal: Njengoko isivakalisi ngasinye se-imeyile enentlonipho sivezwa, hlaziya isigqibo sakho ngenjongo yokwenene yomnye umntu, ubhale impendulo efanelekileyo.
e-10.material: Uthumele isiphakamiso sokwenza igadi yemifuno yesikolo ku-Ms. Rowe, onoxanduva esikolweni. I-imeyile yempendulo ivulwa isivakalisi esinye ngexesha.
e-10.s.s1.prompt: Funda i-imeyile ngecandelo elinye ngexesha, kwaye ngamaxesha onke khetha isigqibo sakho sokuba isiphakamiso siza kwamkelwa na.
e-10.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ugqibe ukuba isivakalisi esitsha sitshintsha intsingiselo yesangaphambili okanye siyaqhubeka nayo.
e-10.s.s1.hint.1: Phawula amagama atshintsha ukuhamba (But) namagama athile afana nemihla neenjongo.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Sesiphi isigqibo esinengqiqo kakhulu esivela kwesi sivakalisi kuphela?
e-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukudumisa kuphela akubonisi isigqibo. Kusenokuba kukuqala kokwala ngobunono, okanye kukubulisa nje. Isivakalisi esilandelayo sibalulekile.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Interesting' kukudumisa, kodwa ayiligama lesigqibo okanye lokwamkela.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikwazi ukwazi isigqibo okwangoku, kwaye sidinga ukubona isivakalisi esilandelayo.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Intetho yoluhlu 'this year' ibalulekile. Ukuba uyifundile njenge-'polite refusal' kwinyathelo lokuqala, esi sivakalisi siyixhasa loo ndlela yokufunda, kodwa ayikabi kukwala ngonaphakade.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ithi lo nyaka unzima, kwaye ayithi nto ngamva.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ithetha ukwala ngokupheleleyo ukusuka ngoku, ngaphandle kwalo nyaka.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ithe kuphela 'this year's budget.' Ayizange ithi kukwala ngonaphakade.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yingxaki yebhajethi kuphela, ngoko iya kusonjululwa kungekudala sibe sinokuqala kulo nyaka.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Funda kuse esivakalisini sokugqibela ugweba kwakhona.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuhamba kutshintsha nge-'But', kwaye umhla wokugqibela (Friday), injongo (director), nexesha (March) zithile. Nokuba uyifunda njengengekagqitywa okanye njengenjongo yokuqhubela phambili, ukuba wawugqibe ngokuqinileyo kwangaphambili ku-'polite refusal', kufuneka uhlaziye isigqibo sakho.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kukuhlonipha nje, ngoko akukho mfuneko yokuphendula.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Umntu ofuna ukwala kuphela akanikezi umhla wokugqibela (Friday) nenjongo (director, March) ngeenkcukacha.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Akakagqibi ukuba uyala na, kwaye ukhangela ulwazi lokugweba.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Le nayo yindlela enokwenzeka yokufunda. Kodwa 'I will show it to the director before the March budget meeting' isondele ekufuneni ukuqhubela phambili.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Unomdla, kwaye ucela izixhobo ukuze kuqhutyelwe phambili kwintlanganiso yebhajethi yoMatshi.
e-10.s.s1.reflect: Chaza indlela isigqibo sakho esatshintsha ngayo kwinyathelo lesithathu emva kokuba ugwebe 'difficult' kwinyathelo lesibini. Ngawaphi amagama (But, by Friday, before ... March) abe sisizathu?
e-10.s.s2.prompt: Bhala indlela isigqibo sakho kwinyathelo lokuqala esahluke ngayo kwesakho kwinyathelo lokugqibela (lesithathu), nokuba ziintetho ezithini ezenze umahluko. Ungabhala ngesiKorean okanye ngesiNgesi. (Ukuba akutshintshanga, bhala isizathu sokuba kutheni sahlala sinjalo.)
e-10.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye ukhetho owalwenza kwinyathelo 1.
e-10.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kweentetho ezivele ngokutsha kwinyathelo lesi-3 (But, Friday, March, njalo njalo), khetha enye etshintshe isigqibo sakho.
e-10.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: At first I thought ... but because of ...
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ngokucacileyo isigqibo owasikhetha kuqala?
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhethe ubhale ukuba yeyiphi intetho esuka kwi-imeyile etshintshe isigqibo sakho?
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ukuba akutshintshanga, ngaba ucacise isizathu usebenzisa izalathiso ezisuka kwi-imeyile?
e-10.s.s2.model.0: At first I thought it was a polite refusal, but in the last sentence I saw that after 'But' she asked for an estimate by Friday, so I changed to thinking she is interested.
e-10.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela u-Ms. Rowe impendulo ngesiNgesi. Bonisa enkosi nokuqonda imeko, uthembise ukuthumela oko kucelwe ngosuku olucelwe (Friday).
e-10.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ufunde oko kucelwe kwisivakalisi sokugqibela se-imeyile (yintoni, kwaye ngaphambi kwexesha elithini) uyiphindele impendulo yakho njengoko injalo.
e-10.s.s3.hint.1: Zama ukubhala ngolu landelelwano: isivakalisi esinye senkosi, isivakalisi esinye sokuqonda, isivakalisi esinye sesithembiso.
e-10.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Thank you for your reply. ...
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba impendulo yakho iphendule ngqo isicelo sokugqibela sika-Ms. Rowe?
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba kukho intetho ebonisa ukuba uyaqonda ukuba ibhajethi yalo nyaka ayivumeli?
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ukuphephile ukubonisa ukudakumba okuninzi kakhulu?

e-01.title: Dibanisa imigca emibini yesaziso sethala leencwadi ukukhangela isicwangciso sika-Ben
e-01.goal: Dibanisa imigca emibini eyahlukileyo yesaziso (ishedyuli eqhelekileyo nokungafaki kweli veki), ugqibe ngosuku ngosuku ukuba isicwangciso somhlobo wakho siyasebenza na, uze umxelele ngesiNgesi.
e-01.material:
Isaziso esisemnyango wethala leencwadi lesikolo (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Library
Open: Mon, Wed, Fri  3:00-4:00
This week: closed on Friday (cleaning day).

Umhlobo wakho u-Ben wathi, "Let's go to the library on Thursday and on Friday this week!"
e-01.thinking.0: Dibanisa imigca emininzi yesaziso ukwenza isigqibo
e-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngaba u-Ben angasisebenzisa ithala leencwadi ngoLwesine nangoLwesihlanu kweli veki, njengoko ecwangcisile?
e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga uLwesine noLwesihlanu ngokwahlukeneyo, uthelekise oko umgca ngamnye wesaziso uthi ngalo suku.
e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela ukuba umgca we-'Open' nomgca we-'This week' benza imisebenzi eyahlukileyo na.
e-01.s.s1.r.a: Usenokuba awuzifundanga zombini imigca yesaziso. Khangela ukuba uLwesine ukwiintsuku ezivulekileyo na, nokuba ikho inqaku elikhethekileyo ngoLwesihlanu.
e-01.s.s1.r.c: ULwesihlanu uhlala evuliwe, kodwa umgca we-'This week' uthi into eyahlukileyo ngeli veki.
e-01.s.s1.r.d: Jonga kwakhona ukuba uLwesine ukuluhlu lweentsuku ezivulekileyo (Open).
e-01.s.s1.explain: ULwesine ayisosinye seentsuku ezivulekileyo (Mon, Wed, Fri), kwaye nangona uLwesihlanu uhlala evuliwe, kweli veki 'closed on Friday'. Ngoko akukho nolunye usuku olusebenzayo.
e-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha yonke imigca oyifunayo ukugweba isicwangciso sika-Ben (uLwesine noLwesihlanu).
e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukususa umgca ngamnye ubone ukuba kuba nzima ukugweba uLwesine okanye uLwesihlanu na.
e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gcina amazwi ka-Ben nemigca yesaziso zahlukile.
e-01.s.s2.r.a: Oku kusetyenziselwa ukugweba uLwesine, kodwa lo mgca wodwa awukuxeleli ngoLwesihlanu weli veki (uhlala evuliwe). Khangela ukuba ufuna omnye umgca na.
e-01.s.s2.r.b: Ufuna oku ukugweba uLwesihlanu, kodwa lo mgca awuthi nto ngoLwesine. Fumana ukuba ngowuphi umgca okuvumela ukugweba uLwesine.
e-01.s.s2.r.c: Sisihloko nje, ngoko asinalo ulwazi ngeentsuku.
e-01.s.s2.r.d: Esi sivakalisi sisiphakamiso sika-Ben. Isiphakamiso yinto ekufuneka ikhangelwe, asingobungqina.
e-01.s.s2.explain: Umgca we-Open ubonisa ukuba uLwesine asisosuku olulivuliweyo, kwaye umgca we-This week ubonisa ukuba uLwesihlanu uvaliwe kweli veki. Nawuphi na wodwa awukwazi ukugweba zombini iintsuku. Ukuba ukhethe omnye kuphela, khangela ukuba lusiphi usuku olushiyekileyo.
e-01.s.s3.prompt: Phendula ku-Ben ngesiNgesi ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini. Nika isizathu sokuba ungakwazi ukuya ngoLwesine nesizathu sokuba ungakwazi ukuya ngoLwesihlanu.
e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala, bhala isivakalisi esinye uxelela u-Ben 'hayi, asikwazi.'
e-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala isivakalisi esinye sesizathu sikaLwesine nesinye sesizathu sikaLwesihlanu, nganye idityaniswe nomgca wesaziso.
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba unike isizathu sikaLwesine nesizathu sikaLwesihlanu?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba unokuthi imigca yesaziso isuka phi isizathu ngasinye sakho?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ukuba ucebise olunye usuku, ngaba ukhangele ukuba lusuku oluvulekileyo ngokwenene? (ukhetho)

e-02.title: Fumana isivakalisi esidida kumyalezo wesimemo
e-02.goal: Fumana izivakalisi ezimbini kumyalezo omfutshane wesimemo ezingahambelaniyo, uzibhale kwakhona ukuze abahlobo bangabi nokudideka.
e-02.material: Lo ngumyalezo uJun awuthumele kubafundi esifunda nabo. (Ubhalwe ngamagama kuphela. Umgca ngamnye unenani.)
e-02.thinking.0: Fumana ulwazi oluphikisana nalo ngokwalo phakathi kwezivakalisi
e-02.prereq.1: Izenzi ezilula ezifana ne-come / start the game
e-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isivakalisi esinye esinokudida abahlobo. Ngumgca ongahambelaniyo nesinye isivakalisi.
e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa 'ixesha lokufika' 'nexesha lokuqala'. Liliphi eliza kuqala?
e-02.s.s1.explain: Ithi yiza ngo-10, kodwa ithi umdlalo uqala ngo-9:30. Unokutshintsha nokuba ngumgca 3 okanye umgca 4. Umgca 1 (ipaki ngeCawa) nomgca 2 (indawo yepaki) abaphikisani nomnye umgca. Ukuba uthelekisa imigca enamanani (amaxesha), ungabona ingxabano.
e-02.s.s2.prompt: Kunokwenzeka ntoni ukuba lo myalezo uthunyelwe njengoko injalo?
e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga umhlobo ofumana umyalezo ujonge iwotshi enze kanye oko kuthethwayo.
e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa: ngaba umdlalo wawusele uqalile ngexesha lokufika kwalo mhlobo?
e-02.s.s2.o.a: Umhlobo ofika ngo-10 uphosa umdlalo osele uqalile.
e-02.s.s2.o.b: Umhlobo ofika ngo-9:30 ulinda epakini engenanto phambi kokuba umdlalo uqale.
e-02.s.s2.r.b: Oku kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kumhlobo okholelwa ekuqaleni ngo-9:30 afike ngelo xesha. Kodwa eyona ngxaki ithe ngqo ebangelwa yingxabano ne-'come at 10' yi-a.
e-02.s.s2.o.c: Abahlobo baphela befika ngoMgqibelo endaweni yeCawa.
e-02.s.s2.r.c: Usuku lucace ngokucacileyo ukuba yiCawa. Ingxaki lixesha.
e-02.s.s2.explain: Ingxaki ixhomekeke ekubeni ulandela liphi kumaxesha amabini. Ukuba ulandela i-10, uphosa umdlalo (a); ukuba ulandela i-9:30, udideka kuba yahlukile kuloo nto ithethwa ngomnye umgca (b). Nakweyiphi na indlela, kwenzeka kuba amaxesha amabini ahambelani.
e-02.s.s2.acc.0: Umhlobo okholelwa ekuqaleni ngo-9:30 afike ngelo xesha alinde nawo luphumo lokwenene lengxabano. a ngowomhlobo olandele u-'10', kwaye b ngowomhlobo olandele u-'9:30'.
e-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kwakhona izivakalisi ezimbini (ixesha lokufika nexesha lokuqala komdlalo) ngesiNgesi ukuze amaxesha ahambelane.
e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Unokutshintsha elinye kuphela kumaxesha amabini. Gqiba kuqala ukuba ngeliphi ulitshintshayo.
e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Beka ixesha lokufika phambi kwexesha lokuqala, uze ubhale amaxesha omabini njengamanani ecaleni komnye ukuze uwathelekise.
e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kumaxesha amabini owabhalileyo, liliphi eliqala kuqala? Ngaba ixesha lokufika liza kuqala?
e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucinge ukuba umhlobo uya kwenza ntoni emva kokufunda lo myalezo?

e-04.title: UJun ufuna ntoni? Phinda ubuyisele ingcinga yakho njengoko izikhokelo zongezwa
e-04.goal: Ixesha ngalinye isikhokelo sencoko songezwa, qikelela kwakhona oko umethethi akufunayo, uze uchaze indlela utshintshe ngayo uqikelelo lwakho.
e-04.material: Ekhaya, uJun uthetha nomama wakhe. Amazwi akhe aza kubonisa isahlulo esinye ngexesha.
e-04.thinking.1: Phinda ubuyisele isigwebo ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutsha
e-04.prereq.0: Amagama alula afana ne-small, hurt, closed
e-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda amazwi kaJun isahlulo esinye ngexesha, uze ngalo lonke ixesha uqikelele oko uJun akufunayo.
e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana igama elitsha elinye kwesi sahlulo.
e-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela enye ngenye ukuba uqikelelo lwakho lwangaphambili luyahambelana nesikhokelo esitsha.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Luluphi uqikelelo olunengqiqo kakhulu lokuba uJun ufuna ntoni kumama wakhe, kwesi sivakalisi sodwa?
e-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Awukwazi ukuyazi kanye ngesivakalisi esinye. Usenokufuna izihlangu ezintsha, okanye usenokuba uxela nje inyani.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Akukho nto kwizikhokelo ngeklasi ye-P.E. okanye ukuyishiya.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Uthemba ukuba umama wakhe uza kumthengela izihlangu ezintsha.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Usenokuba uthi nje izihlangu zakhe zincinci.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Jun: "They hurt when I run. We have P.E. (physical education) class tomorrow."
e-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Funda isalathiso esitsha uqikelele kwakhona oko uJun akufunayo.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 'It hurts' ne-'P.E. tomorrow' kunye kwenza kucace ukuba ufuna ukuba kusonjululwe ngomso. Ukuba wacinga kwinyathelo lokuqala ukuba 'uxela nje inyaniso', kufuneka ulungise uqikelelo lwakho apha.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ufuna ukuyilungisa ukuze iinyawo zakhe zingabuhlungu phambi kweklasi yePE ngomso.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuthi iinyawo zakhe ziyabuhlungu kwaye unePE ngomso sisalathiso sokuba ufuna kusonjululwe. Oko kwakunokwenzeka kwinyathelo lokuqala, kodwa ngoku akuhambelani nezalathiso.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Akazange athi ufuna ukutsiba. Ukufunda njengokukhangela isisombululo ukusuka ku-'it hurts' no-'P.E. tomorrow' kusondele kwizalathiso.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Funda isalathiso sokugqibela uqikelele oko uJun aya kukwenza.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ivenkile ivaliwe namhlanje, ngoko 'izicathulo ezintsha namhlanje' ziyavalwa. Amacebo afana nokuya kwenye ivenkile okanye ukuthetha ngezicathulo zomhlobo ayahambelana nesalathiso esitsha. Ukuba ucinge kuphela ngezicathulo ezintsha, kufuneka utshintshe icebo lakho lokuzithenga namhlanje.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Uya evenkileni namhlanje athenge izicathulo ezintsha.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ayihambelani nesalathiso sokuba ivenkile ivaliwe namhlanje.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ucela umama wakhe ukuba aye kwenye ivenkile ekuseni kakhulu ngomso.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Elicebo linokwenzeka nalo. Kodwa ingcamango uJun ayizisayo ekugqibeleni imalunga nomhlobo.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ucinga ngokuboleka izicathulo kumhlobo onobukhulu beenyawo obufanayo.
e-04.s.s1.reflect: Ingaba uqikelelo lwakho lutshintshe kwinyathelo ngalinye? Ukuba lwatshintsha, khankanya isivakalisi e-1 esiyisizathu.
e-04.s.s2.prompt: Sisiphi isalathiso esenza ukuba umnqweno kaJun ufundeke njengotshintsho ukusuka ku-'ukuthetha nje' ukuya ku-'ukusombulula ngomso'?
e-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funda izalathiso ezintathu ngocwangciso ufumane apho inani leziqikelelo ezinokwenzeka laqala ukuncipha khona.
e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Funda ngesalathiso ngasinye sisusiwe uvavanye ukuba intsingiselo 'ufuna ukulungisa' isayo.
e-04.s.s2.r.b: Esi sivakalisi sasikhona ukususela ekuqaleni, kwaye sodwa sasivumela iziqikelelo ezininzi.
e-04.s.s2.r.c: Esi sisalathiso savala indlela e-1 yokusombulula (ivenkile), kodwa umnqweno wokusombulula wawusele ubonakaliswe zizalathiso zangaphambili.
e-04.s.s2.explain: 'It hurts' ne-'P.E. tomorrow' zidala ingxaki enexesha eliqinisiweyo, ngoko uJun ufundeka ngokufuna kusonjululwe.

e-05.title: Ukuxelela abantu abahlukeneyo ngemeko enye
e-05.goal: Bhala ngesiNgesi malunga nemeko enye (ukungabikho kwiklabhu ngenxa yedyunti yogqirha wamazinyo) kutitshala nakumhlobo, nganye ngesandi nobude obufanelekileyo.
e-05.material: Kukho iklabhu yesiNgesi namhlanje ngo-3:30, kodwa unedyunti yogqirha wamazinyo ngexesha elifanayo, ngoko awukwazi ukuya. Kufuneka uxelele utitshala weklabhu, uMs. Han, ngomyalezo, nomhlobo kwiklabhu enye ngombhalo omfutshane.
e-05.thinking.0: Thelekisa uze ukhethe iintetho ngokwabantu nemeko
e-05.prereq.0: Iintetho ezineenkcubeko ezinje nge-could / would / please
e-05.s.s1.prompt: Ngowuphi umyalezo ongcono wokuthumela kuMs. Han? (Uza kubhalela umhlobo wakho kwinyathelo elilandelayo.)
e-05.s.s1.hint.0: Khangela ukuxolisa okanye isicelo kumyalezo ngamnye.
e-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zithelekise ngokucinga ukuba utitshala uya kuziva njani xa efumana umyalezo ngamnye.
e-05.s.s1.r.b: Isizathu nemeko ziyacaca, kodwa ngaphandle kokuxolisa okanye isicelo kunokuvakala ngathi uyabhengeza nje kutitshala.
e-05.s.s1.r.c: Inika isizathu kodwa ivakala ngathi ishenxisa ityala, nto leyo enokuphumela ekucaphukisweni komnye umntu.
e-05.s.s1.r.d: Isandi sinobuhlobo kodwa sisaneenkcubeko. Igrama ilungile nayo.
e-05.s.s1.explain: a ne-d zinokuxolisa, isizathu, nesicelo. a isemthethweni ngakumbi kwaye d ilula, kodwa zombini zineenkcubeko. b icacile kwaye ihloniphekile, kodwa ngaphandle kokuxolisa okanye isicelo inokufundeka njengengaphantsi kwenkcubeko. Kwi-c, isandi sokushenxisa ityala sinokwenza omnye umntu angaphatheki kakuhle. Inqanaba lokusemthethweni elilindelekileyo liyahluka ngesikolo nangotitshala.
e-05.s.s1.acc.0: Ukuba usondele notitshala, isandi esinobuhlobo kodwa esineenkcubeko njenge-d sifaneleka nasiso. A yintetho esemthethweni ngakumbi.
e-05.s.s1.acc.1: b inesizathu nemeko ecacileyo nesihloko esineenkcubeko (Ms. Han), ngoko ilungile njengesaziso esifutshane. Kodwa ngaphandle kokuxolisa okanye isicelo, inokufundeka njengengaphantsi kwenkcubeko kune-a ne-d.
e-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umyalezo kuMs. Han ngokwakho. Thi awukwazi ukuza nesizathu (idyunti yogqirha wamazinyo), uze uquke intetho eneenkcubeko (ukuxolisa okanye isicelo).
e-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala cinga ngoko wawuya kukongeza ukuba ubuthetha notitshala wakho ngesiKorea, uze ufumane indlela yokuthi loo ntsingiselo ngesiNgesi.
e-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukubhala ngolu cwangciso: isivakalisi sokungeza, isivakalisi sesizathu, isivakalisi sesicelo.
e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isandi sesingenakucaphukisa utitshala xa esifunda? Leliphi igama elenza loo msebenzi?
e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ukuba wongeze into ofuna ukuyifumana (njengokufumana izixhobo), ingaba ivakala njengesicelo?
e-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha ngumbhalo omhlobo kwiklabhu enye. Bhala imeko efanayo ngokufutshane ngamagama ali-18 okanye ngaphantsi, ngesandi esikhululekileyo. (Ungasebenzisi iintetho ezisemthethweni ezinje ngo-Dear okanye i-I'm afraid.)
e-05.s.s3.hint.0: Gcina kuphela ulwazi ekufuneka ulugcine kumyalezo wakho kutitshala (isizathu, nokuba awukwazi ukuza).
e-05.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa ukufinyezwa (can't) okanye amagama amafutshane, uze ubale amagama.
e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Xa kuthelekiswa noko ukubhalele utitshala, ngawaphi amagama anyamalele nangawaphi ahlalayo?
e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nangona ifutshane, ingaba umhlobo wakho angayazi isizathu?

e-06.title: Fumana izivakalisi ezinezicwangciso eziphindaphindwayo kumyalezo weqela
e-06.goal: Fumana izivakalisi ezimbini zeshedyuli ezingahambelaniyo kumyalezo weqela, chaza ukuba ngubuphi ukudideka obunokubangela, uze uzibhale kwakhona.
e-06.material: Lo ngumyalezo owapapashwa yinkokheli yeprojekthi yeqela lesayensi kwincoko yeqela. (Umgca ngamnye unenombolo. Amaxesha emva kwemini abhalwe njenge-p.m.)
e-06.prereq.0: by / before / after + usuku okanye ixesha
e-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isivakalisi e-1 esinokubangela ingxaki kumalungu eqela alandela ishedyuli. Ngumgca onocwangciso lwexesha olungahambelani nolunye isivakalisi.
e-06.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana yonke imigca enamaxesha, ubeke amaxesha ngocwangciso lwexesha.
e-06.s.s1.hint.1: Lithini elisaza kuqala: ixesha lokugqibela lokuthumela okanye ixesha lokudibanisa?
e-06.s.s1.explain: Ixesha lokudibanisa yiLwesine 4:30 p.m., kodwa ixesha lokugqibela lamacandelo yiLwesine 9:00 p.m. Ixesha lokugqibela lisemva kwexesha lokudibanisa, ngoko imigca emibini (umgca 2 no-umgca 3) iyaphikisana. Imigca 1 no-4 imalunga nexesha lokugqibela leLwesihlanu nokushicilela, ngoko ayiphikisani omnye nomnye.
e-06.s.s2.prompt: Kuya kwenzeka ntoni ngokwenene ukuba abantu balandela lo myalezo njengoko unjalo?
e-06.s.s2.hint.0: Masithi ilungu leqela lithumela inxalenye yalo kanye 'ebusuku boLwesine'.
e-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yintoni inkokheli ibe seyigqibile ngelo xesha?
e-06.s.s2.o.a: Inxalenye ekufuneka ifike nge-9 isenokungafikanga xa amacandelo edityaniswa ngo-4:30.
e-06.s.s2.o.b: Onke amacandelo aya kufika phambi komsebenzi wokudibanisa, ngoko iposta igqitywa kwangoko.
e-06.s.s2.r.b: Umsebenzi wokudibanisa ngo-4:30 p.m., kwaye amacandelo amkelwa ngaphambi kwe-9:00 p.m. Phinda uthelekise amaxesha.
e-06.s.s2.o.c: Akukho xesha lisele lokushicilela phambi kweklasi yeLwesihlanu.
e-06.s.s2.r.c: Ingxaki kucwangciso ngaphakathi kweLwesine. Kukho ixesha elisele ukuya kusasa leLwesihlanu.
e-06.s.s2.explain: Ukudibanisa kuza kuqala, kodwa amacandelo amkelwa kamva kunoko, ngoko inxalenye ethunyelwe emva kwexesha isenokushiywa.
e-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kwakhona omnye wemigca ephikisanayo (okanye omibini) ngesiNgesi. Yenza amaxesha neentsuku zihambelane.
e-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala gqiba ukuba lawaphi amaxesha emigca emibini oza kuwatshintsha.
e-06.s.s3.hint.1: Emva kokuyitshintsha, phinda ufunde ukuhlola ukuba ucwangciso 'ixesha lokugqibela lamacandelo → ukudibanisa → ukushicilela' lulungile ngamaxesha.
e-06.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Please send me your part by ...
e-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ixesha lokugqibela lokufumana amacandelo liphambi kwexesha lokudibanisa? Thelekisa amaxesha amabini njengamanani.
e-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba kusekho ixesha phambi kwexesha lokugqibela lasekuseni leLwesihlanu?
e-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndihambise ixesha lokudibanisa kamva ndongeza isizathu.

e-07.title: Dibanisa izaziso ezimbini ukusebenza ixesha lokuhamba kwebhasi
e-07.goal: Dibanisa izaziso ezimbini ezibhengezwe ngemihla eyahlukileyo (ixesha lokuqala kunye notshintsho lwamva) ukusebenza ixesha elitsha lokuhamba, uze ulungise ukungaqondi komhlobo usebenzisa ubungqina.
e-07.material:
Izaziso ezimbini zibhengezwe kwibhodi yezaziso kwindawo yokumisa ibhasi. (Zibhalwe ngamagama kuphela.)

Isaziso A (sibhengezwe ngoMvulo): "Bus 5 leaves at 7:40 a.m."
Isaziso B (sibhengezwe ngoLwesithathu): "From Thursday, Bus 5 will leave 10 minutes earlier. Please be at the stop on time."

Umhlobo wakho uHana: "Bus 5 leaves at 7:50 on Thursday."
Umhlobo wakho uJae: "Then on Friday it leaves at the same time as on Thursday."
e-07.thinking.0: Dibanisa iinxalenye ezininzi zolwazi ukufikelela esigqibeni
e-07.thinking.1: Qonda indlela isaziso sakamva esitshintsha ngayo esangaphambili
e-07.prereq.0: Iintetho ezinje nge-earlier / later / from + usuku
e-07.s.s1.prompt: Ugweba ngezaziso ezimbini, ingaba uHana ulungile?
e-07.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa imihla izaziso ezimbini ezabhengezwa ngayo. Leliphi lakamva?
e-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba i-earlier ithetha 'kwangoko' okanye 'kamva', ubale ukusuka kwi-7:40.
e-07.s.s1.o.a: Ulungile. Ukudibanisa imizuzu eli-10 ka-B kwi-7:40 ka-A kunika i-7:50.
e-07.s.s1.r.a: Usenokuba ufunde i-earlier ngokungathi yi-'later'. Phinda uhlole intsingiselo ye-earlier.
e-07.s.s1.o.b: Uphosakele. B ithi ihamba imizuzu eli-10 kwangoko, ngoko yi-7:30.
e-07.s.s1.o.c: Asikwazi ukuthi. Asikwazi ukugqiba ukuba leliphi lezaziso ezimbini elichanekileyo.
e-07.s.s1.r.c: Izaziso ezimbini aziphikisani. B sisaziso sakamva esitshintsha ixesha luka-A.
e-07.s.s1.explain: Isaziso B sabhengezwa kamva yaye sithi imizuzu eli-10 kwangoko kunexesha luka-A. Imizuzu eli-10 phambi kwe-7:40 yi-7:30.
e-07.s.s2.prompt: UJae wathi, "On Friday it's the same time as Thursday." Ungayigweba njani le ntetho ngezaziso?
e-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukutshintshisa 'on Thursday' no-'from Thursday' uthelekise ukuba intsingiselo iyatshintsha na.
e-07.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela amagama esazisweni akuxelela ukuba iphela nini.
e-07.s.s2.o.a: 'From Thursday' ithetha ukuqhubeka ukusuka kuLwesine ukuya phambili, ngoko iLwesihlanu ifana neLwesine.
e-07.s.s2.o.b: 'From Thursday' ithetha ukuba iLwesine kuphela etshintshayo ngosuku olo.
e-07.s.s2.r.b: 'From Thursday' ne-'on Thursday' ziyahluka. I-'From' ikhomba kwindawo yokuqala.
e-07.s.s2.o.c: ULwesihlanu alukho ngqo kwisaziso, ngoko kubonakala ukuba kufuneka uhlole.
e-07.s.s2.r.c: Ukuqaphela kunengqiqo. Kodwa intetho ethi 'From Thursday' sele iquka iintsuku ezilandelayo.
e-07.s.s2.explain: 'From Thursday' ithetha ukuba ixesha elitsha lisebenza ukuqala ngoLwesine. Ukuba akukho gama likuxelela ukuba liphela nini, iLwesihlanu iyafana. Ukucinga ngokubuza abasebenzi kuba akubhalwanga ngqo nako kunengqiqo.
e-07.s.s2.acc.0: Ukufuna ukubuza abasebenzi kuba iLwesihlanu ayibhalwanga ngqo kwisaziso nako kunengqiqo. Kodwa 'From Thursday' ngokuqhelekileyo ithetha ukuba iyaqhubeka emva koko.
e-07.s.s3.prompt: Phendula uHana ngesiNgesi. Thi ibhasi ihamba ngexesha elithini ngoLwesine, uze unike isizathu esisekelwe kwizaziso.
e-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala kwixesha lesaziso A, ubhale oko isaziso B sithi sitshintsha.
e-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yongeza isivakalisi e-1 sethi 'kutheni i-7:50 iphosakele.'
e-07.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: I think it leaves at ... because ...
e-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba kucacile ukuba ubungqina bakho buvela kwesiphi isaziso kwezi-2?
e-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uchaze ukuba kutheni i-7:50 iphosakele?

e-08.title: Bhala isaziso seklabhu esingadidi
e-08.goal: Khomba ukuba kutheni isaziso esingacacanga sidida, uze ubhale kwakhona umxholo ofanayo ngesiNgesi ukuze nabani na ofunda aqonde ngaphandle kwempazamo.
e-08.material:
Esi sisaziso esibhengezwe kwibhodi yezaziso.

"Art Club meeting this Friday or next week at 3 or 4 in room 2 or the gym. Bring something."

Abahlobo abafunde esi saziso baye kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo baza abakwazanga ukudibana.
e-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke into abahlobo abadideke ngayo.
e-08.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula amacandelo esaziso aqulathe i-'or', namacandelo anamagama angacacanga angakwazi ukuxela intsingiselo yawo (njenge-something).
e-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola icandelo ngecandelo ukuba umfundi angakholelwa kwinto e-1 kuphela aze enze.
e-08.s.s1.r.a: Kuyinyani ukuba umhla awucacanga. Hlola ukuba ezinye izinto ziyamvumela umfundi enze into e-1 kuphela nazo.
e-08.s.s1.r.b: Kuyinyani ukuba ixesha alicacanga. Hlola ukuba ezinye izinto ziyamvumela umfundi enze into e-1 kuphela nazo.
e-08.s.s1.r.c: Kuyinyani ukuba indawo ayicacanga. Hlola ukuba ezinye izinto ziyamvumela umfundi enze into e-1 kuphela nazo.
e-08.s.s1.r.d: Kuyinyani ukuba oko kufuneka kuziswe akucacanga. Hlola ukuba ezinye izinto ziyamvumela umfundi enze into e-1 kuphela nazo.
e-08.s.s1.r.e: Kucacile ukuba yintlanganiso kabani. Khetha kuphela amacandelo umfundi anokuwaqonda ngeendlela ezi-2 okanye ngaphezulu.
e-08.s.s1.explain: Umhla, ixesha, nendawo konke akucacanga ngenxa ye-'or', kwaye oko kufuneka kuziswe akucacanga kuba awukwazi ukuxela ukuba yintoni i-'something'. Ukuba ukhethe ezinye kuphela, vavanya kwakhona ukuba umfundi angenza into e-1 kuphela kwizinto osezishiyile.
e-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kwakhona isaziso sentlanganiso efanayo ngesiNgesi ngaphandle kokungaqondi. Gqiba ubhale usuku, ixesha, indawo, noko kufuneka kuziswe.
e-08.s.s2.hint.0: Entlokweni yakho, yenza itheyibhile apho umisela into e-1 yosuku, ixesha, indawo, noko kufuneka kuziswe.
e-08.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba umhlobo ongazange aye kwintlanganiso unokuyifumana esebenzisa esi saziso kuphela.
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isaziso sakho sinalo naliphi na icandelo apho ubeke khona ukhetho olu-2 nge-'or'? (Umzekelo, amaxesha amabini okanye iindawo ezimbini)
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Nokuba ngumhlobo ekubonayo okokuqala, ingaba angazi ukuba aye phi?
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba umhla (usuku) kunye nexesha zimiselwe into enye?
e-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ithoni yobuhlobo. I-'or' yento omele uyizise kukukhetha nje, ayinabubumbulu.

e-11.title: Ukuhlola isibakala esithi 'Scores dropped, so it's the Wi-Fi's fault'
e-11.goal: Vavanya ukuba ingqiqo yonobangela nesiphumo kwileta yephephandaba lesikolo iyanela na, gqiba ukuba ulwazi olufunekayo lokuhlola isibakala lulwaluphi, ubhale ngentlonipho isichasi kumbhali ngesiNgesi.
e-11.material:
Ileta yomfundi kwiphephandaba lesikolo (umbhalo wengcinga):

"Last year, our school's average English score was 78. This year, after the school started free Wi-Fi, it fell to 72. So the Wi-Fi caused the drop. Therefore we should turn the Wi-Fi off."
e-11.prereq.0: Iintetho zonobangela nesiphumo ezifana ne-therefore / so / caused
e-11.prereq.1: Ukungavumelani ngentlonipho (I see your point, however ...)
e-11.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isivakalisi esinye kulo mbhalo esithetha ngokungathi yinyani eqinisekileyo nangona ubungqina bungekho.
e-11.s.s1.hint.0: Hlela umgca ngamnye ube yi-'into eyenzekileyo' okanye i-'ibango ngonobangela okanye oko kufuneka kwenziwe.'
e-11.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya ukuba imigca yamabango ilandela kwimigca yenyani ephambi kwayo kuphela na.
e-11.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 ('So the Wi-Fi caused the drop.') utsiba usuka kwi-'kwenzeka emva kwexesha' uye kwi-'ngunobangela.' I-'we should turn it off' kumgca wesi-4 nayo ayinabungqina, kodwa ixhomekeke kutsiba lomgca wesi-3. Imigca yoku-1 nowesi-2 ziintetho zenyani ngamanqaku nexesha.
e-11.s.s2.prompt: Luluphi ulwazi olunokukunceda uhlole i-'The Wi-Fi is the cause of the score drop'? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
e-11.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngezizathu ezimbini ngaphandle kwe-Wi-Fi zokuba kutheni amanqaku enokutshintsha.
e-11.s.s2.hint.1: Gweba ukuba ukhetho ngalunye lunokunceda ukuhlela ukuba i-Wi-Fi okanye esinye isizathu ngunobangela.
e-11.s.s2.o.a: Indlela amanqaku esiNgesi atshintshe ngayo kunyaka ofanayo kwesinye isikolo esingenayo i-Wi-Fi
e-11.s.s2.r.a: Ukuthelekisa yindlela elungileyo. Jonga nokuba ungakuhlola ukwahlukana kobunzima bovavanyo okanye kwiqela labafundi.
e-11.s.s2.o.b: Ukuba uvavanyo lwalo nyaka lwalunzima kunolwalunyaka ophelileyo
e-11.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba uvavanyo lutshintshile, sisizathu esibalulekileyo. Jonga nokuthelekisa nezinye izikolo nakwiqela labafundi.
e-11.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba abafundi bayithanda kangakanani iklasi kusenokunxulumana namanqaku, kodwa akunakuhlela ukuba i-Wi-Fi ngunobangela na.
e-11.s.s2.r.d: Ixabiso linxulumene nesigqibo sokuyifaka, kodwa alinanto yakwenza nesizathu sokuba kutheni amanqaku ehle.
e-11.s.s2.o.e: Ukuba abafundi bazisebenzisile iifowuni zabo ngexesha leklasi yesiNgesi
e-11.s.s2.r.e: Olu lulwazi oluhlola indlela. Jonga nezinye izizathu (uvavanyo, iqela labafundi, ezinye izikolo).
e-11.s.s2.o.f: Ukuba abafundi balo nyaka liqela eliyahlukileyo kubafundi bonyaka ophelileyo (izakhono, inani lokufunda, njalo njalo)
e-11.s.s2.explain: Ukuthelekisa nezinye izikolo (a), ukuhlola ubunzima bovavanyo (b), nokuhlola ukuba yasetyenziswa ngokwenene ngexesha leklasi (e) kunye nomahluko weqela labafundi (f) kukuvumela uhlele ukuba i-Wi-Fi okanye esinye isizathu ngunobangela. Inani labafundi abathanda iklasi nexabiso lokufakwa alinxulumananga ngokuthe ngqo nonobangela.
e-11.s.s2.acc.0: Ukuthelekisa nezinye izikolo nokuhlola ubunzima bovavanyo sele kwanele ukunceda ukuhlela ezinye izizathu.
e-11.s.s2.acc.1: Ukuba uhlola nokuba yasetyenziswa ngokwenene ngexesha leklasi, ungabona indlela i-Wi-Fi enokuba isebenze ngayo.
e-11.s.s2.acc.2: Umahluko weqela labafundi nawo sisizathu esinye esiqhelekileyo sotshintsho lwamanqaku.
e-11.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela umbhali isichasi sezivakalisi ezi-2-3 ngesiNgesi. Yamkela inyani yokuba amanqaku ehlile, kodwa ucacise ukuba ibango lokuba i-Wi-Fi ngunobangela alinelanga okwangoku, unike indlela enye yokuhlola okanye esinye isizathu.
e-11.s.s3.hint.0: Qala, kwisivakalisi esinye, yamkela inxalenye umbhali ayifumene ichanekile (amanqaku ehlile).
e-11.s.s3.hint.1: Emva koko bhala isizathu esinye esithile sokuba kutheni kungonelanga ukuyibiza ngokuthi 'the cause' (siyiphi esinye isizathu okanye ukuthelekisa).
e-11.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: I see your point, but ...
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ukubhala kwakho kwamkele inyani yokuba amanqaku ehlile?
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba unike isizathu esinye sokuba kutheni kungonelanga ukuthi ngokuqinileyo yi-'the cause'?
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ithoni ichaza ingqiqo ngaphandle kokuhlasela umbhali?

e-12.title: Xa 'It's fine.' ingalunganga: ukwenza incoko
e-12.goal: Gweba ukuba amagama afana ne-'It's fine.' anokungathethi oko athetha ngqo, wenze incoko emfutshane yesiNgesi ngaloo meko ukuze uhlangabezane neemeko.
e-12.material: UA uthi kuB, "I'm sorry I forgot to call you last night." UB angaphendula oku ngeendlela ezininzi. (Kubhalwe ngamagama kuphela.)
e-12.prereq.1: Iintetho ezifana ne-Are you sure? / You sound ...
e-12.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kweempendulo zikaB, yeyiphi inokuba iyabhenela ukuba kulungile kodwa ngokwenene akulunganga?
e-12.s.s1.hint.0: Funda impendulo nganye ngokuvakalayo, uzicingele ukuba umntu okulungeleyo ngokwenene angayithetha ngolo hlobo na.
e-12.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba impendulo nganye ibandakanya 'isizathu sokuba kulungile' okanye 'into efunwayo', okanye ezo zilahlekile.
e-12.s.s1.r.a: Ithetha ngokukhululekileyo ngelixa inika isizathu. Isizathu sokuba kulungile sisesivakalisini.
e-12.s.s1.r.c: Isenokungabikho lula kuba ithethwe ngamandla kakhulu, kodwa kunzima ukugweba imvakalelo ngesivakalisi kuphela.
e-12.s.s1.r.d: Ithi kulungile, kodwa ikwathi ifuna ntoni. Ifihla kancinci.
e-12.s.s1.explain: Ukuba umntu uthi kuphela i-'It's fine.' emfutshane, ethe tyaba, akukho sizathu okanye mvakalelo ibonakalayo, ngoko ifundeka lula njengokufihla imvakalelo engaphakathi. Kodwa awukwazi ukuqiniseka ngesivakalisi kuphela, kwaye kufuneka ujonge ithoni nemeko kunye.
e-12.s.s1.acc.0: I-'totally' egxininiswa ngokugqithisileyo inokuba luphawu lokugquma ukungabi lilungile.
e-12.s.s1.acc.1: Ukuthikazela ku-'Just...' luphawu lokuba umntu akalunganga ngokupheleleyo. Kodwa kunqabile, kuba umntu uchaza inxalenye yendlela avakalelwa ngayo.
e-12.s.s2.prompt:
Yenza incoko yesiNgesi ehlangabezana neemeko ezingezantsi. Qala umgca ngamnye nge-A: okanye B:, ubhale imigca emi-4 ubuncinane.
Iimeko 1) UB uthi kulungile ngamagama afana ne-'fine' okanye 'okay', kodwa ubonakala enomsindo.
Iimeko 2) UA ukubona oku abuze ngobunono (sebenzisa uphawu lombuzo).
Iimeko 3) Ekupheleni, uB uthi kancinci ngendlela ayivakalelwa ngayo ngokwenene.
e-12.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe imeko enye (ukulibala isithembiso, isipho, isiphumo sovavanyo, njalo njalo).
e-12.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza impendulo yokuqala kaB ibe mfutshane, uqale umbuzo kaA ngokufutshane, njenge-'Are you sure?'
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba unokuvakalelwa encokweni ukuba amagama kaB ('fine') kunye nemvakalelo yokwenene kaB ziyahluka? Ngowuphi umgca?
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Kumgca wokugqibela, ngaba uB uthe kancinci ngendlela ayivakalelwa ngayo ngokwenene?
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.0: Ukuhamba apho imvakalelo yokwenene ibonakala kwimeko yokucela uxolo.
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.1: Incoko ehlangabezana neemeko ezifanayo ngemeko eyahlukileyo.
